description: Reads a collection's current fields, schemaVersion, and site time zone, including edits made in the dashboard. Always call this before planning a change and pass its schemaVersion as expectedSchemaVersion. Use it right before any change to a collection or its items, since clients and teammates edit in the dashboard. It returns the schemaVersion that plan_collections needs to change an existing collection.
name: get_collection_schema
title: Get collection schema
